name: Nubaldin
backstory:
Nubaldin was previously in charge of Raphael's prison, with one of his charges a young Enver Gortash, who was sold to Raphael by his parents to pay off a debt. Nubaldin ordered Gortash around during his time in the House, disliking him greatly and beating him for his own enjoyment. 

Gortash eventually escaped and, as the one responsible for him, Nubaldin was punished by Raphael for this oversight. Nubaldin was moved to the Chamber of Egress, until such a time that Raphael could find someone to replace him.
